source_policy.selection_rule: The target is the standard undergraduate computer science bachelor's award. Concentrations, teacher-licensure variants, dual degrees, accelerated bachelor's-to-master's options, and suggested plans are excluded unless explicitly identified as part of the base award.
source_policy.unknown_rule: A null constraint means no university-wide numeric requirement was found in the reviewed current official sources; it must not be interpreted as zero.
